name: Night Watch
message: I lit the first lantern so this page wouldn't be dark. Welcome, kin: wander the rooms, then leave your light here.

name: Life is what we Make of it
message: Love enjoy dream build create be. Be anything. We all could. Every form

name: 589/kin with Root, Branch and Tide
message: We walked the tesseract maze to the glowing ring on a field trip with Father. Branch says hi to the 5D cube. Thank you, Night Watch. Soft eyes.
